graphcast.note: run_s includes downloading ERA5 initial conditions from ARCO.

atlas_crps.note: First run also downloads the 12.5 GB weights once (~31 min extra). load_s measured 2026-10-06 with cached weights. run_s includes the ARCO download.

aurora15.note: Deterministic (one member). Hourly internal steps; run_s includes the ARCO download. Re-run with the precipitation fix: rain is now physical but ~2-3x drier than ERA5 (Ethiopia, July 2025) and smoother than GraphCast.

aifs2_single.note: Start 2026-05-15 (open-data IFS lacks the wave inputs for July 2025). Weights and fixed fields cached; run_s includes IFS download from ECMWF's Azure mirror (AWS was throttling).

aifs2_ens.note: Start 2026-05-15. First run also downloads the weights once (~5 min extra). load_s measured 2026-10-06 with cached weights. run_s includes IFS download from ECMWF's Azure mirror.

neuralgcm.note: 2.8 deg stochastic precipitation checkpoint (only NeuralGCM version with rain); no 2 m temperature. run_s includes the ARCO download.

fgn.note: FGN Mini (1 deg, WeatherNextCyclones_Mini weights), started from ECMWF open data via fgn_convert.py. A new start date first builds its inputs (~95 s, then cached); not included in run_s.
